t: Cards can only interact with other cards that are on the same channel. This allows a player to have multiple sets of routing logic on the same network.$(br2)For example, Extractor cards on the 'Orange' channel will only attempt to insert into 'Orange' colored Insert Cards, and will ignore all other cards.
物流卡仅能与同频道的其他卡交互。可借此在同一网络上构建多组路由逻辑。$(br2)例如，在“橙色”频道的提取模式卡只会尝试输出至同为“橙色”频道的输入模式卡，并忽略所有其他物流卡。

For example, set an Extract Card to the 'Orange Channel' with a filter for cobblestone, and another extract card to the 'Black Channel' with a filter for coal. Then place them in the same node. $(br2)An Orange channel inserter can sit above a furnace, with a black channel inserter below. This will ensure that only cobblestone goes into the top of the furnace, while coal goes below.
比如，设置一张“橙色”频道过滤圆石的提取卡和一张“黑色”频道过滤煤炭的提取卡，并放入同一节点。$(br2)将一张橙色频道输入卡连至熔炉上方，一张黑色频道输入卡连入其下方。如此熔炉上方只会收到圆石，熔炉下方只会收到煤炭。
